name: Girlfriends: Rich vs Rebel
source:
Introducing “Girlfriends: Rich vs Rebel” – A love story that’s in your hands—vote for your girlfriend!

Experience the life of an average high school student, driven by a rebellious spirit that sets you apart. Uncover deep feelings concealed beneath the composed facade of your childhood friend and class president, Saki Urakaze. Yet, your attention is irresistibly drawn to Emi Otoishi, the enigmatic "bad girl" who unexpectedly becomes your roommate. As you navigate lighthearted moments and intense emotional trials, shape your relationships with Saki and Emi, discovering the essence of love, forgiveness, and personal growth. Who will win your heart in this epic high school love saga: Emi or Saki? The choice is yours!
translation:
隆重推出“女朋友：富人与叛逆者”——一个掌握在你手中的爱情故事——为你的女朋友投票吧！

体验一名普通高中生的生活，在叛逆精神的驱使下，你与众不同。揭开儿时好友兼班长浦风咲平静外表下隐藏的深厚感情。然而，你的注意力不可抗拒地被音石惠美所吸引，这位神秘的“坏女孩”意外地成为了你的室友。当你度过轻松的时刻和激烈的情感考验时，塑造你与咲和惠美的关系，发现爱、宽恕和个人成长的本质。在这部史诗般的高中爱情传奇中，谁会赢得你的心：惠美还是咲？选择权在你！
